* fix(step): measure step.duration from the first retry attempt (#5774)

HelperStep.run() and FuncStep.run() overwrote startTime on every attempt,
so a retried step reported only the duration of its last attempt. Keep the
start time of the first attempt, as recordStep() already intends.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(actor): use step-level retry so the retry rule doesn't leak

The global recorder.retry() rule stayed registered after the test and
retried errors in later test files (AsyncWrapper tests failed in CI).
step.retry() removes its rule once the step finishes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(step): measure step.duration from the first retry attempt (#5774) (#5775)

* fix(step): measure step.duration from the first retry attempt (#5774)

HelperStep.run() and FuncStep.run() overwrote startTime on every attempt,
so a retried step reported only the duration of its last attempt. Keep the
start time of the first attempt, as recordStep() already intends.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(actor): use step-level retry so the retry rule doesn't leak

The global recorder.retry() rule stayed registered after the test and
retried errors in later test files (AsyncWrapper tests failed in CI).
step.retry() removes its rule once the step finishes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
